02/09/2026
Trying to be honest about the scorecard.
There is a version of success that looks very convincing from a distance: money came in, things moved, nothing fully fell apart. But I have been thinking about the difference between being busy and building a life I actually want to recognise.
Envy is ugly, but it is also information. I do not want to let it turn into self-pity. I want to figure out what it is pointing at.

I have been in Bangalore for a few months now, and I keep running into the same pattern: people larping a life instead of living it.
Not the fun kind of LARP. I mean the everyday roleplay: founder without a product, researcher without research, operator without operations. Everybody has the vocabulary. Everybody has the vibes. Nobody has a body of work.
